why: RJ-P01, pending #3692: the catalog has no image.crop yet, and the JPEG's pixel check waits on image-codecs (qbtrix/creative-core#562). PhotoExportPackTests runs the plan half on Linux: it crops the 3:2 landscape to 4:5 off-centre, exports at Pixels 1080 x 1350 and finds the red marker at the file's centre within 2 px.
